LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we indicate that something belongs to somebody? 2. Why do we use articles in sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: A learner pays attention to details and correct errors in sentences.

● Communication and collaboration: A learner uses articles and possessives to communicate clearly and effectively.

Values:
Respect: A learners corrects use of articles and possessives makes learners use correct titles while addressing people

Link to other subjects:

French, German, Chinese, and Arabic have determiners as an area of study.

Suggested Learning Resources

Braille/flash cards, braille reading machines, video/audio recorders, language games
